title: Local AI Websites options
description: False or enabled:false is a complete no-op, including stale options. Native resolved document defaults are overlaid per key by effective page options; lists/corpus replace atomically.

publish-assets.description: Publish the exact prepared asset-receipt.json inventory beside the selected manifest automatically. Explicit opt-in; no directory recursion, downloads or inference during rendering.

source-pages.description: Explicit local published HTML URLs with opted-in .local-ai-source excerpts. A reader loads this finite catalogue explicitly. Root-relative URLs are rebased within the Quarto output root, preserving deployment subpaths. Use the actual published filename; QMD filenames are not guessed.

proposal-format.description: Cited JSON validates every generated quote and selected-excerpt offset before showing any claim. Quote alignment does not prove support. Plain text retains the legacy unreviewed compatibility mode without per-claim citation checks.

graphs.description: Public knowledge-graph catalogue discovery. Defaults to all when knowledge-graph metadata is active, otherwise false. All includes the separate CV graph if public and search-eligible; this does not combine graph navigation or admit summaries as reviewed AI evidence.

oneOf.description: Explicit public JSON file, at most 262144 bytes, copied automatically for HTML panels. A relative URL resolves beside the input document; a /root-relative path resolves within the Quarto rendering context (project root, or input directory for a standalone document) and becomes a document-relative output URL, preserving site subpaths. Symbolic links, query, fragment, percent escapes, backslashes, whitespace and authored traversal are refused. Native UTF-8 document context and the project offset preserve tested ASCII and Latin-1 consumer roots with spaces, nested input names and custom output directories. Arbitrary Unicode/CJK extension-path support is not established. SDK, WASM and model assets require an exact author resources inventory; no directory is recursively copied. Omit for static search only.

manifest.description: False clears an inherited manifest and keeps static source search. Otherwise use an explicit public local JSON URL; project-wide root-relative URLs preserve nested paths.

corpus.description: Explicit corpus of one to 64 local published HTML URLs containing opted-in .local-ai-source excerpts. A reader loads this corpus explicitly. This does not publish pages, scrape unselected content, infer source review or load any model. Root-relative URLs are rebased within the Quarto output root; use the actual published filename. Existing source-pages retains its separate eight-page limit.
